Boomers wiww, weww, go BOOM when they die, stunning towews! .⁰(☒д☒ₒ )⁰.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 34 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Incoming enemy!|Beginning of Wave 34 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]]}} }} ==Description== The '''Boomer''' is a legacy enemy that appears in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, both of which are only available through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has decently high health and walks at a rather slow speed. Upon death, it will explode into a bile bubble that stuns towers. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Boomer''' is a bloated enemy with a light green skin color and a green torso and darker green legs. It has a bloating stomach and its torso occasionally emits green particles. It is faceless and trudged when it walks. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Boomer''' is a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a green skin color and a crimson-brown torso, waist and legs. It has a bloated chest and stomach with tumors, which has a dark green explosive device strapped on it. The explosive has an orange caution symbol, red and blue wires and an antenna with a flashing red light on it. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Boomer''' was a bloated enemy with a light green skin color and a green torso and darker green legs. It had a bloating stomach and its torso occasionally emitted green particles. It had a drooling zombie face and trudged when it walked. When it was first added, its walking animation had it flailing its arms around. }} ==Strategy== *When first encountering it, the '''Boomer''' does not pose as a serious threat as there are few enemies to take advantage of the '''Boomer's''' stun. **However, at later waves, the '''Boomer''' will be accompanied by many strong enemies that spawn behind it, like the [[Giant Boss]] and [[Summoner Boss]]. **The '''Boomer''' can also potentially spawn in hordes from [[Mystery Boss]]es, which may lead to many more towers getting stunned. *Killing the '''Boomer''' before it gets within range of your towers is the most ideal way to deal with '''Boomers'''. Keep in mind that it has quite a long stun time. **Placing your towers away from the path is a good way to avoid the '''Boomer's''' stun. **Long-range towers, such as the [[Turret]] are the best at keeping a distance away from the '''Boomer'''. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can be very effective against the '''Boomer''' as they cannot be stunned. ***The [[Engineer]]'s sentries can also be useful, as the sentries cannot be stunned and the '''Boomer''' does not deal damage to units. *The [[DJ Booth]] allows towers to shoot the '''Boomer''' from further away, potentially defeating it before it blows up near your towers. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse towers of the '''Boomer's''' stun. *The [[Gladiator]] and Level 4 [[Warden]] can block the '''Boomer's''' stun. **This is ineffective if there are multiple '''Boomers''', as there is a cooldown after blocking a stun where the [[Gladiator]] is unable to block stuns. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Boomer.png|First version, second animation (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) BoomerPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyBoomer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} April Fools 2022 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Boomer''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyBoomerIconIG.png|'''Boomer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Boomer''' is based on the ''Left 4 Dead'' zombie, the [[w:c:left4dead:The Boomer|Boomer]]. *This [[Enemies|enemy]] replaced the [[Boomer 1]], [[Boomer 2]] and [[Carrier]] after the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. *Prior to the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the '''Boomer''' used an edited version of the {{RLinkC|7131361|Sad Zombie}} face from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
